page_title: MCI 3-1 MNU | Manchester City v Manchester Utd 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play.

90+8' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Manchester Utd.
90+6' Here comes a substitution. Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) is brought on as a substitute for Phil Foden.
90+6' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+4' Manchester City keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! Rodri produces a great pass that finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
88' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
88' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Manchester City earn a corner.

87' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a cross in and finds Erling Haaland inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
85' Andy Madley blows his whistle and it's Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
84' The Manchester City players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Erik ten Hag has decided to make a change. Omari Forson (Manchester United) replaces Alejandro Garnacho.
82' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kobbie Mainoo.
80' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Julian Alvarez tees up Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Andre Onana.
79' Antony (Manchester United) dribbles into the box, but Ederson is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
77' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Andy Madley who sees an offensive foul.
76' Antony (Manchester United) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
75' Here's the change. Marcus Rashford leaves the pitch and Antony (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
73' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 24:2.

71' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the roof of the net, but Andre Onana pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
70' The opposing goalkeeper had set up the wall well before the free kick was executed and Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) failed to send the ball over. Great defensive action!
69' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Willy Kambwala (Manchester United) replacing Jonny Evans.
68' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) receives a yellow card for infringement.
66' Andre Onana (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
64' Andre Onana (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andre Onana, who smothers the ball.
61' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

60' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andy Madley blows for a foul. Manchester City have a free kick.
60' John Stones (Manchester City) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
59' The substitution is prepared. Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jeremy Doku.
57' Erik ten Hag (Manchester United) gets a yellow card, off the field.
56' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Phil Foden (Manchester City) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Rodri, then produced a nice strike into the top left corner. The score is 1:1.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
53' Manchester Utd are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
50' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find Bernardo Silva, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.

50' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Andre Onana with a brilliant diving save!
49' Phil Foden (Manchester City) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
46' The foul by Scott McTominay (Manchester United) was seen by Andy Madley who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
46' Referee Andy Madley blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana reads it well and gathers the ball.

45+3' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester City.
45+3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45+3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Manchester City have a corner.
45+1' Phil Foden plays a pass to Erling Haaland (Manchester City), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Phil Foden (Manchester City) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
42' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies high over the bar.
40' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
38' Andy Madley blows his whistle as Erling Haaland (Manchester City) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

37' Phil Foden (Manchester City) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
35' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
34' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

34' Rodri (Manchester City) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Andre Onana pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Andy Madley has a clear sight and sees a foul from Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
33' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar!
32' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
30' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Bernardo Silva. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
29' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings it in and Bernardo Silva gets on the end of it, but Andre Onana shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
28' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
26' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

26' Rodri (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
25' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
23' Manchester City take a short corner kick.

23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
20' It could have been a good chance to score! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to release Marcus Rashford with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
19' Phil Foden (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

19' Phil Foden (Manchester City) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same. Manchester City force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
18' The resulting corner, taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), comes to nothing.
18' A cross into the box from Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Phil Foden (Manchester City) whips in a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana is well positioned and punches the ball away.

15' Phil Foden (Manchester City) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Andre Onana is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
13' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Phil Foden (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
12' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches a cross from the corner, but Ederson is alert to thwart the effort.
12' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Manchester Utd have a corner.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) volleys the ball from the edge of the box and it goes in off the inside of the left post. Bruno Fernandes provided the assist. What a finish! 0:1.
6' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
4' Kevin De Bruyne floats in a cross for Erling Haaland (Manchester City), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post.
4' John Stones (Manchester City) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
2' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes it short.
1' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
